articles.title: The photo of Harry Kane that raises suspicions: Has he won the Ballon d'Or?
articles.standfirst: An enigmatic post from Bayern Munich shows the British striker wearing an impeccable tuxedo just days before the grand gala of world football
articles.summary: An enigmatic post from Bayern Munich shows the British striker wearing an impeccable tuxedo just days before the grand gala of world football
articles.body:
The football landscape is in the final countdown to discovering the new king of international football , and every detail is being scrutinized closely. With the award ceremony just around the corner, the media environment and fans are experiencing days of maximum tension and all kinds of theories.

In this atmosphere of anticipation, the Bavarian club's official accounts have shaken up the digital ecosystem with an impeccable image of their great star . The snapshot of the English forward dressed to the nines immediately set off alarm bells over the possibility of a leak about the winner of the coveted trophy .

The first comments from fans on social media platforms pointed directly to a veiled confirmation from the German club. However, the reality behind this carefully crafted photograph has a purely sporting and promotional background with a view to Europe's top competition.

The real reason behind the elegant image of discord

As detailed by the sports outlet Goal, the Munich side’s post was nothing more than a promotional teaser designed for a key Champions League clash . The phrase "The show is about to begin" accompanied the striker’s portrait before facing an old Premier League acquaintance like Arsenal .

The England national team's captain is a key figure in this type of continental clash due to his historic numbers against the London side. It is no coincidence that the fearsome striker has amassed a devastating record of 15 goals in 22 matches against the Gunners , making the British club one of his favorite victims.

Within the Bavarian dressing room, there is full awareness of the strategic value Kane has in deciding clashes of the highest European demand. After having scored against the London side in the previous edition of the continental tournament, the club wanted to emphasize his leadership by sporting an aesthetic typical of the big red-carpet occasions.

The curious origin of a film montage

To understand the origin of this famous image, we have to go back to August 2023, when the striker's arrival in Munich was made official . The German channel Sport1 revealed that those shots were taken at the iconic Filmtheater am Sendlinger Tor cinema to simulate a Hollywood production.

The complexities of the signing caused certain delays in the recording schedule of that audiovisual presentation material . As the portal Abendzeitung explained at the time, the initial filming had to be carried out using the player's own stunt double, with Kane later inserted through digital editing techniques.

Despite the stir caused by the use of this historical file, the Ballon d'Or predictions remain very wide open among the year's biggest names . Emerging figures like Lamine Yamal and established stars of Kylian Mbappé's stature share the spotlight with the English striker in the shortlist of candidates.

The final race for the world throne

Just days before the official verdict is revealed, analysts from international publications such as France Football or the magazine Kicker continue debating the merits accumulated throughout the campaign . The Englishman's goalscoring performances in the Bundesliga and the Champions League give him strong arguments for being among the top places.

The debate goes beyond a simple anecdote on social media to focus on the individual and collective merits accumulated by the contenders over the last season . Kane’s consistency in front of goal remains his main footballing credential compared to the media impact and the titles won by his direct competitors.

As the Champions League clash gets underway and attention temporarily shifts to the pitch, the question mark over the individual award will remain until the very last second . The photo dressed to the nines will ultimately go down as a viral anecdote on the eve of the most important night in global football.

articles.title: Messi receives the Princess of Asturias Award for Sports and earns a huge ovation
articles.standfirst: Princess Leonor was in charge of presenting it to him in the presence of the King and Queen
articles.summary: Princess Leonor was in charge of presenting it to him in the presence of the King and Queen
articles.body:
Lionel Messi (Rosario, 1987) was awarded the Princess of Asturias Award for Sports this afternoon in a solemn ceremony at the Campoamor Theater in Oviedo, the usual venue for these Awards, which bring together each year the most outstanding figures in the Arts, Sciences, Culture, and Sports.

Leo received the award from Princess Leonor, in the presence of King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia. The Campomar Theater gave Leo a tremendous ovation... that reached all the way to Argentina, homeland of the star.

Messi arrived in the official car at the Theater at around 6:10 p.m. (20 minutes before the event) and made his way toward the venue in front of hundreds of people who crowded together to see him, especially in some cases, and the rest of the award winners.

Leo is a four-time Champions League winner, World champion, two-time Copa América champion, and a player with almost all the records in this sport worldwide. But that is not enough to be Princess of Asturias for Sports. The Jury -the director of MARCA, Juan Ignacio Gallardo, is one of its members- has also recognized the Argentine's charitable work: his work, for example, with the Leo Messi Foundation and as a UNICEF ambassador, focused on promoting access to education and healthcare for children in vulnerable situations. Recently (another example) he donated money to help restore the Madrid mountain range burned by last summer's wildfires. That... plus everything he does that is not publicly known. An essential aspect for this Princess of Asturias Award.

After the ceremony, Leo will head directly to Asturias airport to fly straight to New York, where tomorrow he plays with Inter Miami in the MLS.

articles.title: Vinícius' ex Virginia Fonseca confirms reconciliation with Zé Felipe hours before El Clásico: "Our love never ceased."
articles.standfirst: The Brazilian influencer surprised everyone with the announcement of her reunion with the father of her three children, just a few weeks after her separation from the Real Madrid footballer.
articles.summary: The Brazilian influencer surprised everyone with the announcement of her reunion with the father of her three children, just a few weeks after her separation from the Real Madrid footballer.
articles.body:
Vinicius Jr. will not have just any Sunday. While Real Madrid prepares to face Barcelona in El Clásico , news related to his love life once again shifted the spotlight off the pitch.

Virginia Fonseca, his ex-partner, confirmed that she has resumed her relationship with Brazilian singer Zé Felipe. The announcement came at a critical moment for Vinicius, both in footballing terms and in matters of love, after his relationship with the influencer ended.

Now, Virginia and Zé Felipe are betting on their love story again, with a joint post that included a phrase full of meaning: “Our love never ceased to exist”.

Virginia Fonseca and Zé Felipe confirm their reconciliation

The Brazilian influencer and the singer shared the news of their reconciliation through social media. After some time apart and having gone their separate ways, both decided to give themselves a new chance and rebuild their relationship.

The post did not go unnoticed because of the message that accompanied the images, in which the couple made it clear that their feelings were still present despite the breakup. The phrase about a love that never disappeared became one of the central details of the announcement.

The ring that caught attention in the images

Beyond the confirmation of the reconciliation, one of the elements that stood out in the post was the ring that Virginia showed alongside Zé Felipe. The detail added a new dimension to the announcement and sparked interest about the couple's future.

Virginia and the singer have three children together. They got married on March 26, 2021, after beginning their relationship in 2020. They had three children: Maria Alice, Maria Flor, and José Leonardo. Their reunion marks a new chapter for both of them, who had already shared a life together before their separation and divorce, which was officially finalized in July 2025.

The news comes ahead of Vinicius's Clásico

The reconciliation became known hours before the clash between Real Madrid and Barcelona, one of the most anticipated matches on the football calendar. Vinicius, however , will not be able to take part in the match due to the suspension he received following his sending-off against Villarreal.

The Brazilian forward will have to watch the match from the sidelines, while his name once again appears in the news over a matter related to his personal life.

The timing coincidence between the Clásico and Virginia's announcement adds interest to a story that connects football with the world of celebrities.

articles.title: Kane is present in London for the Ballon d'Or and Messi is not expected
articles.standfirst: Confidence in the English player's camp that he will receive the award tonight
articles.summary: Confidence in the English player's camp that he will receive the award tonight
articles.body:
To mark the 70th anniversary (1956) in which Stanley Matthews was awarded as the first-ever Ballon d'Or , the ceremony will take place in London and not, as is usually the case, in Paris . There, in 1993, a Harry Kane was born who has made his presence felt... in the hope of being rewarded tonight.

Winner of "MARCA's 100 of 2026" , confidence is sky-high both in the English striker's inner circle and within the Bayern Munich delegation. After yesterday afternoon's match against Freiburg , which ended in victory for the Bavarian side, he is already in London accompanied by his entire entourage... and they have set up a headquarters near the Palladium Theatre , where the ceremony will take place.

The truth is that it is the most inscrutable Ballon d'Or in recent memory. However, the feeling surrounding Harry Kane is that, on balance, his candidacy is the one with the fewest cracks. Golden Boot of the 25-26 season, he led Bayern to winning the Bundesliga, DFB-Pokal and German Super Cup... as well as reaching the semifinals of the Champions League , which he also reached with England at the World Cup . In total, he recorded 73 goals across all competitions with an average of more than one goal per match.

"Of course, we would be absolutely delighted if Harry Kane won the Ballon d'Or . Harry sets new records year after year, but his 73 goals for Bayern and the England national team carry particular significance this time," said Jan-Christian Dreesen, CEO of Bayern Munich , who will be present at the gala.

He is not one of the big favorites... but he is among the group of contenders. Above all, after delivering another legendary World Cup . However, despite the rumors circulating about the possibility of him presenting an award tonight, Leo Messi will not be present at the Ballon d'Or ceremony. An award that he has previously won on as many as eight occasions.

The last few days for the Rosario star have been absolutely hectic. After traveling to Oviedo to be honored at the Princess of Asturias Awards , he returned to the United States to play in New York with Inter Miami. He could not avoid defeat, however, against NY Red Bulls. Yesterday he was present at the Messi Cup and, therefore, he is not expected to travel to London.

articles.title: The three criteria for voting for the Ballon d'Or and how the behavior factor influences the final result
articles.standfirst: Individual performance, collective results, and class and fair play are valued
articles.summary: Individual performance, collective results, and class and fair play are valued
articles.body:
The countdown begins to find out the winner of the Ballon d'Or , whose ceremony will be held on Monday the 26th in London. Lamine Yamal, Harry Kane, Rodri, Fabián Ruiz, Erling Haaland, Achraf Hakimi ... are some of the names among the possible candidates to win the prestigious award. But what criteria are taken into account to choose the best footballer of the year?

France Football , the organizer of the award, sets out three main evaluation criteria that the journalists responsible for voting must assess before delivering their verdict: the player's individual performance, collective results, and class and fair play. These factors serve as a reference for determining who has had the best footballing year.

Individual performance is the first major criterion and one of the key aspects in the selection. This section analyzes the footballer's contribution on the pitch: goals, assists, chances created, decisive actions, the ability to make a difference, take on responsibilities within the block...

Collective results also count and are the second major evaluation criterion. In this case, both the titles won with their club and the successes achieved with the national team come into play. We must not forget that, in this case, we are dealing with a World Cup year.

Class and fair play are the third factor, and it is an aspect that goes beyond statistics and trophies. Sportsmanship, respect toward opponents, teammates, and referees, as well as the attitude shown on the pitch, are also part of the assessment. This section focuses on the behavior of footballers and on the way they compete.

The combination of individual performance, collective results, and class and fair play allows the jury to assess the candidates from a broader perspective. With all these factors on the table, the journalists decide which footballer has amassed the most merit to win one of the most prestigious individual honors in world football. The question will be settled on Monday the 26th, when the winner's name is announced and the race for the award comes to an end.

articles.title: Chaos at the Ballon d'Or: the official website accidentally posts stories naming Lamine, Mbappé and Kane as winners
articles.standfirst: Three different reports emerge naming these three players as winners of the award. Minutes later they were deleted
articles.summary: Three different reports emerge naming these three players as winners of the award. Minutes later they were deleted
articles.body:
The 2026 Ballon d'Or reaches its big night surrounded by anticipation and controversy. The emergence of information that seemed to reveal part of the results on channels linked to the award has triggered a flood of speculation on social media and in sports media. These are three news stories announcing Kane, Mbappé and Lamine as winners, each in one.

The news, which is still active, has spread like wildfire and gone viral on social media , "confirming" these three footballers as the overwhelming favorites to win the award that will be presented tonight at around 23:00.

In all the articles, reference was made to their numbers from last season and a review of each of their careers until they presumably achieved the golden award that accredits them as the best player of the 2025-26 season.

"A record-breaking World Cup and another flurry of goals for Real Madrid have earned Kylian Mbappé his first Ballon d'Or ," read the article about the Madrid player, or " at just 19 years old, Lamine Yamal has become the youngest winner in the history of the Ballon d'Or, which was created in 1956 ," said the article that named the Barcelona player as the winner.

According to Daily Mail Sport, the organizers are in shock and are conducting a thorough investigation into what happened in order to take severe measures against those responsible.

In fact, minutes later, the pages in question have been deleted by the Ballon d'Or organization.

articles.title: Lamine Yamal remembers Cubarsí upon winning the Kopa Trophy: "This award should have been for him"
articles.standfirst: The young winger wins the "France Football" award for the best player under 21 years of age
articles.summary: The young winger wins the "France Football" award for the best player under 21 years of age
articles.body:
Lamine Yamal keeps making history. The young blaugrana winger was honored today with the Kopa Trophy 2026 , the annual award presented by the French magazine France Football to recognize the best footballer in the world under 21 years of age. The Catalan international is receiving this award... for the third consecutive year!

Barcelona reigns again in the Kopa Trophy and Lamine Yamal continues to associate his name with this recognition. The winger is credited, once again, with this distinction, whose jury is made up exclusively of Ballon d'Or winners and which has been awarded since 2018 (it was canceled in 2020 because of the pandemic). It is the eighth edition of the award from France Football magazine, and the La Masia graduate won it for the third consecutive time: he already collected it in 2024 and 2025. The first was won by Mbappé , when he was still playing for PSG ; in 2019, De Ligt (Ajax); in 2021, Pedri (Barcelona ); in 2022, Gavi (Barcelona) ; and in 2023, Bellingham (Real Madrid).

Lamine adds a new Kopa Trophy to his honors list, which keeps growing and is overwhelming despite him being only 19 years old. The international winger won LaLiga and the Spanish Super Cup with Barcelona in 2026 and the World Cup with the Spanish national team.

The protagonist, true to his style, wanted to share the recognition with a teammate. “I wish Cubarsí, my teammate, were here. This award should have been for him. I wish he had won it” , said Lamine Yamal in reference to the young Barça center-back, who was also a candidate for the award.

The winger also took the opportunity to thank his two teams for their support and to set himself new goals. “To thank my club and my national team. I have to keep working to win collective and individual titles like this one” , said the footballer from Rocafonda, who insisted on the same idea when asked whether it was the award he had expected to receive tonight: “I would have liked this one to be for Cubarsí” .

The forward from Rocafonda is a regular in the Blaugrana side (in the 25-26 season he featured in 45 matches, in which he scored 24 goals and provided 18 assists, and this campaign he already has 13 appearances, ten goals and ten final passes), and he is also an undisputed starter for Luis de la Fuente 's national team. With Spain , despite his youth, he has taken part in 37 matches, in which he netted 11 goals. At the World Cup this past summer, he was decisive: he played in all eight matches, starting seven of them.

Now, Lamine Yamal (who also won the Golden Boy in 2024, awarded by the Italian sports newspaper Tuttosport to the best footballer in European football under the age of 21) has claimed his third Kopa, which recognizes him as the best footballer in the world under the age of 21. By age, he could still win a couple more...

articles.title: Harry Kane wins the Ballon d'Or in the most suspenseful edition in history
articles.standfirst: What happened after the 2010 World Cup is repeated, and world champion Spain is left without the award
articles.summary: What happened after the 2010 World Cup is repeated, and world champion Spain is left without the award
articles.body:
H arry Kane . That is the name of the day and of the year. The Englishman is the new Ballon d'Or (succeeding Ousmane Dembélé) , as has just been revealed at the ceremony held at London's Palladium Theatre. The Englishman, the big favorite along with Lamine Yamal, beat the Barcelona player and once again leaves Spain without a Ballon d'Or in the year it won the World Cup, as already happened in 2010. On that occasion Messi came out ahead of Iniesta and Xavi Hernández.

The 100 final voters for the award (100 journalists appointed by "France Football" from the top 100 countries in the FIFA rankings) considered HK to be the best of the season in the period under review (August 1, 2025–July 31, 2026). They prioritized voting criterion number one (individual performance) over criterion 2, which is the team’s collective merits, since in this second one Lamine was ahead of HK for having won the World Cup.

Harry is crowned in London, the city where he was born 33 years ago, and received his first Ballon d'Or (he also already has two Golden Boots) accompanied, in the stands, by his wife, Katie Goodland, whom he has known since childhood, his parents and his personal sports doctor, Alejandro Elorriaga from Madrid.

The Englishman has a goal-filled career , although not so many titles, since he has only started winning team honors since his move to Bayern three and a half years ago. But his record in terms of goals last season is unquestionable. That is what the Jury has rewarded ahead of Lamine's World Cup.

Collectively, the Londoner won the German treble (the 26 Super Cup, the 25-26 Cup and the 25-26 Bundesliga) and third place at the World Cup with England (six goals for Harry in seven matches). Individually, HK has these achievements: European Golden Boot, Bundesliga top scorer (36 goals) for the third year in a row, and member of the UEFA Champions League Team of the Year. Other goalscoring records are these:

- HK scored 73 goals (Bayern and England) in 65 matches between August 2025 and July 2026. Only Lionel Messi (82 in 69 in 11/12) surpasses him.

- HK scored 61 goals (and seven assists) with Bayern in 25-26 across all competitions. The last player to score that many goals in a season was Cristiano Ronaldo for Real Madrid in 14/15.

- HK was the second top scorer in the Champions League with 13 goals (Mbappé scored 15) and - HK scored in every knockout round of the Champions League and the German Cup.

- HK is fifth among the players with the most goals in World Cup history , with 14 goals.

articles.title: Thierry Henry breaks his silence on Lamine Yamal and Kate Scott after Ballon d’Or backlash
articles.standfirst: The former France star says his jokes were never meant to disrespect either of them
articles.summary: The former France star says his jokes were never meant to disrespect either of them
articles.body:
Thierry Henry has responded to criticism of his comments at Monday’s Ballon d’Or ceremony, where he co-hosted with Kate Scott . In a video shared after the event, he addressed two moments that drew attention: his question to Lamine Yamal and his exchange with Scott while introducing the Socrates Award.

The first moment came after Yamal won the Kopa Trophy for the third consecutive year. Henry asked whether it was the award the Barcelona star really wanted, a reference to the Ballon d’Or, which Yamal did not win. Some viewers called the question disrespectful and accused Henry of embarrassing the young player; others saw it as a joke.

Henry says he was joking with Yamal

Thierry Henry explained that he asked because it was Yamal’s third time winning the Kopa Trophy and the main award was still to come. He said he understands if people did not like the joke, but stressed that he is a fan of Yamal and loves watching him play. He even described the Barcelona star as one of the players he would pay to watch.

Thierry had praised Yamal’s soccer intelligence before the ceremony, too. Earlier this year, he recalled watching the teenager slow down a Spain counterattack against France in the Euro 2024 semifinals, even though he had a chance to keep driving forward. For Henry, that decision showed how well Yamal understood what his team needed in the moment.

Henry says Kate Scott was in on the joke

The second criticism followed Henry’s exchange with Scott over the Socrates Award, named for the late Brazilian soccer star. Henry joked about the name’s connection to the Greek philosopher and corrected Scott’s pronunciation.

Some viewers thought his response was rude. Andrew Downie, a writer who has written a book about Socrates, also said Scott had pronounced the name correctly.

In his video, Henry said Scott was in on the joke and had played along intentionally. He acknowledged that people might not have found it funny, then asked them to stop calling it disrespectful. “I will never do that,” he said, insisting he would not deliberately disrespect Scott or Yamal.

Thierry Henry is one of France’s greatest soccer players. He won the 1998 World Cup and Euro 2000 with France, starred for Arsenal and Barcelona, and scored a record 228 goals for the London club.

After retiring, he moved into coaching and led France’s Olympic team to a silver medal at the 2024 Paris Games.

Thierry now works as a soccer analyst for CBS Sports, where he regularly breaks down the Champions League alongside Kate Scott, Jamie Carragher and Micah Richards.

His praise of Yamal comes from that vantage point and from years of watching the young Barcelona star grow into one of the game’s biggest names.

articles.title: 2008 Cristiano Ronaldo wins the B.O.A.T. for the best Ballon d'Or in history
articles.standfirst: France Football users vote for the Portuguese for the magazine's new award
articles.summary: France Football users vote for the Portuguese for the magazine's new award
articles.body:
Two days after the Ballon d'Or gala , comes the "presentation" of the B.O.A.T. , that new award invented by the French magazine France Football to crown the best Ballon d'Or in history . And the chosen one is Cristiano Ronaldo . Specifically, the 2008 one.

That was Cristiano's first Ballon d'Or, and it surpassed Messi's 2012 Ballon d'Or in the voting. The Portuguese and the Argentine occupy the top 12 spots, until Ronaldo Nazario appears with his 2002 award.

France Football prepared a special award for the latest edition of the Ballon d'Or, a new prize called the B.O.A.T. (Greatest Ballon d'Or of All Time), in which the usual voting rules were changed. Instead of journalists, it was the magazine's users who were responsible for choosing the best winner of all time.

All the footballers who have won the award on at least two occasions throughout their career were selected... and the vote was for one specific edition. In other words, people voted for, for example, the 2012 Leo Messi, the 2008 Cristiano Ronaldo.. This was the list of names competing for the award.

List of nominees for the B.O.A.T.

Leo Messi (2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2015, 2019, 2021 and 2023)

Cristiano Ronaldo (2008, 2014, 2015, 2016 and 2017)

Ronaldo Nazário (1997 and 2002)

Marco van Basten (1988, 1989 and 1992)

Michel Platini (1983, 1984 and 1985)

Karl-Heinz Rummenigge (1980 and 1981)

Kevin Keegan (1978 and 1979)

Franz Beckenbauer (1972 and 1976)

Johan Cruyff (1971, 1973 and 1974)

Alfredo di Stéfano (1957 and 1959).

A prize that doesn’t come free: one euro per vote

Users could feel like the jury for once... but you had to pay one euro, of course, to take part. In return, two tickets to attend the 2027 gala were raffled off.

According to the French outlet, 5,009 people voted more than once. 44 people voted between 10 and 26 times; 300 people voted between 5 and 9 times and 4,665 people voted between 2 and 4 times. A tidy sum of money to crown their idols.

articles.title: Cristiano Ronaldo's mysterious message after winning the all-time Ballon d'Or
articles.standfirst: The Portuguese star prevailed in a popular vote to take home the BOAT award
articles.summary: The Portuguese star prevailed in a popular vote to take home the BOAT award
articles.body:
A new battle in the eternal head-to-head that divides international football has once again ignited controversy on social media in recent days. This time, the stage was not a playing field, but a massive vote launched to determine which has been the most impactful version of a footballer when it comes to lifting the most renowned individual trophy on the planet . The initiative sought to have fans vote for the most outstanding performance from a select list of historic champions.

The contest promised intense excitement from the very first minute, considering the parity of arguments defended by the followers of the different golden eras of the king of sports. However, the main attention ended up focusing once again on the generational rivalry that defined the last decade and a half , pitting the peak moments of Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi against each other. Fans from every corner of the planet did not hesitate to turn out en masse to support their greatest idols.

By the close of the deadline set by the organizers, the scales tipped in favor of the Portuguese goal scorer, who managed to take the top spot in the ranking and surpass Lionel Messi in the count . In this way, the Portugal national team star claimed the symbolic distinction known as BOAT (Best of All Time) , leaving behind true legends such as Ronaldo Nazário, Johan Cruyff, Marco van Basten, Michel Platini, and Alfredo Di Stéfano.

The memorable 2008 campaign that won over the fans

To understand the reasons for this popular triumph, we must travel back in time to the first spell of Cristiano Ronaldo in the ranks of Manchester United . During the 2007-2008 season, the forward displayed a crushing level of football that dismantled every defense put in front of him, leading the English side to winning the Premier League and the UEFA Champions League in the same season .

That version of the forward combined impressive physical power, dazzling dribbling, and clinical finishing that ultimately translated into 31 goals in the British league . That extraordinary performance allowed him to lift in 2008 the first of the five Ballon d'Or awards he keeps in his personal trophy cabinet. Today, almost two decades later, the fans believed that peak level of performance even surpassed Messi’s legendary 2012 , the year in which the Argentine broke historic goal-scoring records.

The initiative required voters to pay a symbolic one euro for participation and remained open until the final hours of October 27. Although the organization itself quickly clarified that this is not an official gala recognized by FIFA nor the presentation of an additional physical trophy, the news spread like wildfire among the world's leading sports headlines .

The enigmatic post that revolutionized social media

With the victory in the digital polls sealed, attention immediately shifted to the attacker's official platforms to learn his first impressions. Without making direct mention of the contest or posting elaborate speeches, the current Al-Nassr figure chose to express himself very much in his own style, sharing a series of images from his daily work routine along with the word "Preparing" .

The brief message was enough to trigger thousands of interactions and comments from his fans , who interpreted the post as a reflection of his competitive mindset, always focused on training regardless of the accolades that continue to add to his career. The image of the footballer working out at maximum intensity went viral within minutes.

News outlets and media such as TN, Bolavip and El Imparcial picked up on the striker’s unusual reaction, highlighting how the player preferred to keep a low profile regarding the BOAT recognition . Despite not explicitly referring to the poll result, the flood of congratulations from users inundated his profiles, celebrating another milestone in his extensive career.

An eternal debate that transcends popular polls

This type of popular initiative once again brings to the table a discussion that seems to have no end among analysts and football enthusiasts. Sports outlets such as El Diez and Sport highlighted that, beyond the final result or the formal validity of the contest, the massive public response demonstrates the unforgettable cultural impact that both the Portuguese star and the Rosario-born player continue to have on fans worldwide .

Various sports commentators point out that evaluating different eras is always subjective, since each generation remembers with special fondness the moment when they saw their idol reach the peak of his career . However, Cristiano Ronaldo's drawing power on digital platforms once again became a decisive factor in tipping the balance in his favor in this type of international voting.

With this new recognition in the digital sphere, the Portuguese star reaffirms the love affair he maintains with millions of followers around the world . Although the trophy will not physically end up in his display cases, the unanimous support of his fans confirms that the memory of his historic 2008 season remains intact in the collective memory of world football.
